info.title: OmniCourse API
info.description: REST API of OmniCourse: degree audit, curriculum and roadmap planning.

program.description: null when no program was asked for and the caller has not chosen one in onboarding

events.description: By startsOn, then endsOn, then title; [] when nothing is entered

term.description: Term 1, 2 or 3; null for a date of the whole academic year

kind.description: term_start, term_end: first and last day of a term; registration: course registration window; add_drop: add/drop window; exam_period: final exams; holiday: no classes; other: anything else

endsOn.description: Last day, inclusive; equals startsOn for a one-day date

title.example: Đăng ký học phần học kỳ 1

programs.description: Every program, by code, to choose a program grant from

tables.description: Every row this user owns (user_id), by table name, without credentials.

message.description: English text for the developer; the screen words its own message from `code`

programs.description: The programs the caller holds a program-administrator grant for, by code

transcriptCredits.description: credits_differ: the credits the transcript gives that differ from the curriculum; null for other codes

curriculumCredits.description: credits_differ: the curriculum's credits; null for other codes

accountRestored.description: True when this sign-in cancelled a pending account deletion; tell the student.

nameVi.example: Chương trình Tiên tiến ngành Khoa học Máy tính

petition.description: The petition route; a violation never blocks

errors.description: Every error of the file, by record. Any error blocks the whole file.

reviewVersion.description: Send it back with the same csv to the matching confirm route. null while the file has an error: such a file cannot be confirmed.

rows.description: The rows without an error, normalized, in file order

affectedCurricula.description: The union over every changed course: each curriculum that will read new values

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

record.description: The logical CSV record; the header is record 1

action.description: What confirming would do with this row. The other fields are the normalized values it would save.

changedFields.description: For an update: the fields whose saved value differs

current.description: For an update: the saved course as it is now. Otherwise null.

affectedCurricula.description: For an update: every curriculum that links the course and will read the new values

id.description: The curriculum ID: the :curriculumId of the cohort routes

groupIds.description: Ids of the requirement groups it adds up

credits.description: Passed credits of the groups together, overflow from outside them included

countsTowardTotal.description: false: required, but outside the cohort total (GDTC, GDQP-AN)

countsTowardGpa.description: false: left out of the GPA (QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 15.1.c)

status.description: counted_in_other_group: the course is passed and counts in another group (a course counts once, ADR 0013). A failed or in-progress course keeps its own status in every group that lists it.

result.description: The official attempt: the last completed one (Điều 14)

countedInGroupId.description: The group a passed or in-progress course counts its credits in, when that is another group

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

memberships.description: By program code, cohort year, then group name

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

transcriptStatus.description: Official transcript status from the rule engine (QĐ 1175/QĐ-KHTN Điều 14). null: not taken.

readiness.description: Prerequisite readiness for a course not yet passed or in progress. null when prerequisites are not recorded or the course is already passed/in progress.

missingPrerequisites.description: Sorted course codes of unmet prerequisites when readiness is locked.

academicYear.description: ADR 0009: 2026 is 2026–2027. startsOn must fall in 2026 or 2027

term.description: Absent or null: the whole academic year

kind.description: term_start, term_end: first and last day of a term; registration: course registration window; add_drop: add/drop window; exam_period: final exams; holiday: no classes; other: anything else

endsOn.description: Absent: the same day as startsOn. Never before startsOn

title.example: Đăng ký học phần học kỳ 1
title.description: Vietnamese title, as the school words it

sourceUrl.description: The school's announcement; https only. '' or null: none

cohortYear.description: The year the cohort entered the program. One cohort per program and year. Cannot change later.

code.description: The curriculum's code. Trimmed and upper-cased, then checked. Unique among all curricula. Cannot change later.

language.description: Language of instruction, as text. Blank is stored as null.

totalCreditsMin.description: The minimum credits the cohort needs to graduate. null: not recorded, so the audit checks no cohort total (ADR 0013).

code.description: Trimmed and upper-cased, then ^[A-Z0-9]{2,20}$. Cannot change later.

programCode.description: The program of the curriculum the plan is made against.

terms.description: One entry per term, each term once, at most 30 terms and 300 placements in all; a course is placed once. Prerequisites, offering terms and credit caps are not checked here: the rule engine reports them as issues. Left out: an empty plan.

code.description: Trimmed and upper-cased, then checked. Unique among programs. Cannot change later: the read API and the onboarding answers name a program by it.

faculty.description: The faculty that owns the program, as text. It is not a permission boundary (ADR 0011). Blank is stored as null.

trainingType.description: Sets the credit caps and the kind of term 3 (ADR 0012). Set once, on creation (Lâm, 28 November 2026); no route changes it later. Left out or null: not recorded, so the rule engine checks no credit cap.

name.description: The heading as printed; unique within the curriculum

creditsTotal.description: A compulsory group only: the fixed credit total it prints (ADR 0005). null clears it.

creditsTotalMin.description: An elective group only: the minimum credits a student takes from it (ADR 0005). null clears it.

accumulated.description: Credits of every passed course of the curriculum, GDTC and GDQP-AN included (Điều 11.4)

towardTotal.description: Passed credits toward the cohort total

yearLevel.description: Year of study from the accumulated credits (Điều 15.3)

theoryPeriods.description: Theory periods ("LT"); null where the official table leaves the cell blank

prerequisites.description: Codes of the courses that must all be passed first, in this curriculum. null: not recorded (unknown, not "none"). []: recorded as having no prerequisite.

offeringTerms.description: Term numbers (1, 2, 3; ADR 0009, ADR 0012) the course is offered in, in this curriculum. null: not recorded. Never empty.

cohortYear.description: The year the cohort entered the program

totalCreditsMin.description: Credits the cohort needs to graduate, as printed

requirementGroups.description: Every requirement group, by name (the schema stores no printed order). A course may sit in several groups.

courses.description: Standing of every course in the curriculum against the signed-in student’s transcript.

asOfTerm.description: The term the audit stands at the end of (asOfYear, asOfNumber); null: today, the whole transcript

unmatchedCourses.description: Transcript courses no group lists; they count toward nothing

password.description: The current password, asked again before deleting.

The review version covers the rows after parsing: line endings, spaces around a field and the letter case of a course code do not count, and any other difference is refused.

reviewVersion.description: The reviewVersion of the preview of this file. It is refused once the file, the saved values or the references it covers have changed.

csv.description: The whole file as text: UTF-8, optional BOM, comma-delimited, LF or CRLF, fields quoted with doubled quotes where needed. At most 1 MiB and 1,000 data records.

errors.description: Present when a CSV file is refused: where it is wrong. Absent for a malformed request body.

record.description: The logical CSV record, counting the header as record 1: the row number in a spreadsheet. A blank line is not a record. For malformed quoting: the record where reading stopped.

field.description: The CSV column, or null when the whole record is wrong

updates.description: Rows that change a saved course; always 0 for group links

noOps.description: Rows equal to what is saved already

kind.description: registration_soon: a registration window opens in seven days; registration_open: it opens today; term_start: a term starts today; transcript_changed: the student saved a transcript that differs from the one saved before

readAt.description: When the student first marked it read; null while unread

event.description: The school date announced, as it was when the notification was made: it does not follow later edits, and it stays when the date is deleted. The calendar holds the current dates. null for transcript_changed

links.description: Where the notification can send the student, as keys the screen maps to its own routes; the first is the main action. calendar: the school dates; planner: the plans; audit: the degree audit

id.description: The ID of the school date. The date may have been changed or deleted since

nextBefore.description: Send it as `before` for the next page; null when this page is the last

program.description: Program code. Only the programs offered in this release; null until the student picks one (UC-01 A7).

cohort.description: Cohort: the year the student entered the program. Offered: APCS 2024, 2025. Set together with program, and null together with it.

targetGraduationTerm.description: Target graduation term, from the current term up to 8 academic years ahead; null when not set.

creditsPerTerm.description: Credits the student wants to take per term, a whole number of 1 or more; null when not set. Stored as asked: the rule engine applies the credit cap when it builds a plan.

internshipTerm.description: Internship term, in the same range as targetGraduationTerm; "none" when none is planned; null when not set.

finished.description: The student pressed Finish (UC-01 step 9): onboarding then opens no more. Needs a program and cohort. False while onboarding is unfinished, so it resumes at the first unanswered step (UC-01 A8).

placement.description: What is dropped. It is added at the end of each target term in turn.

targets.description: The terms to try it in, each once, at most 30.

reports.description: One per target, in the order sent.

kind.description: violation: breaks a rule. flag: allowed, worth a look. unknown: not recorded, not checked. None blocks saving the plan.

term.description: The term it is about; null for a coverage issue.

position.description: The placement's index in its term's placements; null for a term or coverage issue.

lastTerm.description: The latest term with a placement; null for an empty plan.

share.description: The live link of the plan, or null when the plan is not shared. A plan has at most one.

placements.description: In order, at most 30. A term with nothing placed is left out.

kind.description: null: the program's training type is not recorded.

unread.description: How many of the caller's notifications are unread

sourceUrl.description: https only; '' or null removes it

studentId.description: Student ID (MSSV), 8 digits. Typed by the student; shown to them only, exported with the account and never sent to an AI model (ADR 0019).
